historicalBinding.reason: Historical copied SVGs are CRLF; current render strings are LF. Raw inequality retained; no geometry/text differences after LF normalization.

cause: figure_scene renders polygon line endpoints through _fmt (3 decimal digits), but calls imported figure_svg.angle_arc with unrounded vertex/ray floats.

figure_svg.arc serializes M and A endpoint coordinates with .1f while retaining an unrounded radius. SVG reconstructs a different circle from these rounded endpoints and radius; its center need not equal the polygon vertex.

The discrepancy affects incident boundaries. More endpoint precision reduces but does not remove disagreement with separately rounded line vertices. No pixel measurements or generator answers were used.

candidate.precisionOnly: QA in-memory arc formatter .1f to .6f; 0/64 strict, worst -0.0005379802490440363. Do not adopt as a complete repair.
candidate.boundedOptIn: QA-only align center/rays to the same rounded3 boundary coordinates; trim minor arc by 1e-5 radians at each end; output endpoints6 decimals. All actual serialized circles/extrema remain strictly inside all four halfplanes (positive minimum about0.000075).
candidate.notTolerance: The positive geometric angular gap changes mark endpoints. Checker uses signed distance>=0, not a relaxed acceptance tolerance. Stationary-angle membership uses existing numerical inclusion guard; it cannot turn negative distances into pass.
candidate.limits: Six-decimal endpoint rounding still perturbs circle center. This is a bounded64-case witness, not a proof for arbitrary scale/angles or stroke envelopes. Arc no longer touches the two rays; parent must explicitly accept mark semantics and visual impact.
candidate.integrationRecommendation: Do not globally replace figure_svg.arc formatting. Keep A/C equal marks, labels, radius and statement untouched. Renderer collision sampling should reflect any changed mark geometry.
